sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:fc3094f08361475055771f65eeaad387</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Populate User Details</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading, isTemplate) {
    // Stop processing if the form is loading or if the selection is empty/None
    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        if (newValue === '') {
            // Wipes the fields clean if the user switches back to '-- None --'
            g_form.clearValue('title');
            g_form.clearValue('phone_ext');
            g_form.clearValue('phone');
            g_form.clearValue('e_mail');
            g_form.clearValue('department');
            g_form.clearValue('manager');
            g_form.clearValue('location');
        }
        return;
    }

    // Call the Script Include asynchronously
    var ga = new GlideAjax('GetCatalogUserData');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getUserInfo');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_user_name', newValue); // Passes the selected User ID string
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(response) {
        if (response) {
            // Decode the stringified object sent by the instance
            var userData = JSON.parse(response);

            // Populates your Catalog Item variables safely
            g_form.setValue('title', userData.title);
            g_form.setValue('phone_ext', userData.mobile_phone);
            g_form.setValue('phone', userData.phone);
            g_form.setValue('e_mail', userData.email);
            g_form.setValue('department', userData.department);
            g_form.setValue('manager', userData.manager);
            g_form.setValue('location', userData.location);
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Mahmoud.qanadeel@plat4mation.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 13:18:32</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ae1008fdc3250b1429d17fedd401313c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Populate User Details</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_ae1008fdc3250b1429d17fedd401313c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Mahmoud.qanadeel@plat4mation.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 13:33:12</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Requester Details">b38808348321475055771f65eeaad332</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
